biggest_catch: The friend must open a new S&T personal checking within 90 days of your referral AND land two $500+ qualifying direct deposits within 90 days of opening - and 'qualifying' excludes P2P, account transfers, and all other electronic transfers.
catches: Referrer must have an S&T personal checking account and register at stbank.royalreferralcenter.com, submitting a valid email + phone for yourself and each referred person.
Referrer earns $100 per referred person who fulfills the requirements; only the first referrer of each person is paid.
Cap: $500 in deposits per calendar year per referrer.

Friend must: open a new S&T personal checking within 90 days of receiving the referral email/text; make at least two $500 qualifying direct deposits (payroll, pension, Social Security) within 90 days of account opening; not be overdrawn during that period; provide the same email/phone used in the referral.
Friend ineligible if they have/had signing authority on any other S&T personal checking account or closed one within the last 12 months.
Incentive paid as a direct deposit into the checking account; processing/delivery can take an additional 4-6 weeks after conditions are met.
Plus a $5 Starbucks gift card code for every 10 referrals (limit 5 per calendar year) - a separate kicker.
18+ required; S&T employees ineligible; offer may end or change without notice.
